title: Definition and first modes of union
english: Union is the communal coming together of separate things. It occurs in twelve modes: according to blending, according to heaping, according to nature, according to mixing, according to confusion, according to harmony, according to juxtaposition, according to fusion, according to substance, according to relation, according to composition, and according to person only. Blending occurs with liquids, as with wine and water. Heaping occurs with dry things, as with wheat and barley. Nature occurs with dry and wet, as with earth and water. Mixing occurs with different flours. Confusion occurs with molten things, as with gold and silver, or wax and pitch. Harmony occurs with stones.
